lessons.keep: Make the defect visible before explaining the repair.
lessons.avoid: Replacing the repaired user outcome with a Verified checklist alone.
lessons.open: Benchmark method, competitive claims, customer revenue, actual repaired behavior and sound remain unverified.

Compare overlapping agent cards with a three-column status view to test whether viewers understand parallel work.

comparison.story: Make a competitive claim. → Define the example app. → Explain parallel agents. → Make testing visible. → Illustrate a claimed testing-depth difference. → Describe diagnosis and repair. → Offer business-result social proof. → Convert interest into participation.
